channel.title: Pier & Point · Bridgeview Way midblock, Mission Bay (Blocks 9–9A)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Bridgeview Way midblock, Mission Bay (Blocks 9–9A) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Bridgeview Way midblock, Mission Bay (Blocks 9–9A): New record for Assessor lot 8719004…
item.description: New record for Assessor lot 8719004 (406 China Basin St), the walkway between Blocks 9 and 9A, which was not tracked before. The OCII Commission's Resolution No. 08-2024 (adopted April 16, 2024) approved the design of Lot B of Bridgeview Way, between Blocks 9 and 9A, with local vehicular access removed and removable bollards for emergency vehicle access. Status under construction rests on a Pier & Point site photograph of Oct 27, 2026 showing it fenced, with a mini excavator and graded ground. No source gives a construction start date, an opening date or an expected completion. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-07/2024008.pdf.

item.title: Under construction · Bridgeview Way midblock, Mission Bay (Blocks 9–9A): Pier & Point's founder… (Oct 27, 2026)
item.description: Pier & Point's founder photographs the walkway fenced off, with a mini excavator, graded ground, utility stubs and survey stakes (photograph taken 10:17 camera time, looking north from China Basin St); no source gives a construction start date or an opening date (Oct 27, 2026). Source: Pier & Point, 2026-10-27.

item.title: Planned · Bridgeview Way midblock, Mission Bay (Blocks 9–9A): OCII Commission approves the… (Apr 16, 2024)
item.description: OCII Commission approves the design of Bridgeview Way Lot B between Blocks 9 and 9A: closed to local vehicular traffic, with removable bollards for emergency vehicle access; approval subject to the Executive Director's review of consistency with the SFMTA Vision Zero plan and of mitigation for the Mission Rock parking structure (Apr 16, 2024). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure, 2024-04-16.
